{"metadata":{"description":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client plugin that watches conversations in real time and notifies you the moment a turn finishes — with an on-screen toast and a chime.","id":"gh:1335801423","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-completion-notifier","slug":"JiuMeng329/dsh-completion-notifier","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client plugin that watches conversations in real time and notifies you the "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"moment a turn finishes — with an on-screen toast and a chime."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-completion-notifier"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) **client plugin** that watches conversations in real time and notifies you "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"the moment a turn finishes — with an on-screen toast and a chime."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"一个实时监控对话任务完成的 DSH 插件：当会话的这一轮生成结束时，右上角弹出文字提醒并播放提示音。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 功能特性"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- ✅ 实时检测「对话完成」：agent 停止生成的那一刻即触发
- ✅ 屏上文字提醒：右上角 Toast，自动消失
- ✅ 提示音：Web Audio 现场合成，**无需任何音频资源文件**
- ✅"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" 声音开关：设置 → 常规 →「完成提示音」（`localStorage` 持久化）
- ✅ 双语文案：跟随界面中 / 英文设置
- ✅ 纯客户端插件，无 host 侧副作用"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 安装"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> 前置：已安装 DSH，且有一个 web profile（`dsh web`）。"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### 方式一：从 npm 安装（推荐）"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"然后在 profile 的 patch 层加入一行。编辑 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`："},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"最后重启："},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> 也可以直接用 npm / pnpm 装到 profile 依赖目录：
> `npm install dsh-completion-notifier` 或 `pnpm add dsh-complet"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ion-notifier`（在 profile 目录内执行）。"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 方式二：手动安装（本地包）"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. 把本仓库的 `package.json` 与 `lib/` 放到 DSH 的 profile 依赖目录："},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"2. 按上面的方式把那一行写进 `cordis.patch.yml`，然后重启 `dsh web`。"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## 使用"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"1. 打开 web 界面，正常发起一轮对话；
2. 等 agent 这一轮回答结束，右上角会弹「任务完成」Toast，同时响两声提示音；
3. 想关掉声音：设置 → 常规 →「完成提示音」。"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## 工作原理"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"DSH 运行时的 `sessions` 列表里，每个会话带一个 `running` 布尔位：agent 生成期间为 `true`，本轮结束翻回 `false`。插件在 `shell.overlay`（"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"全屏浮层插槽）里渲染一个监听组件，跨渲染比较该位："},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- `true → false` ⇒ 判定「这一轮刚完成」⇒ 弹 Toast + 播提示音；
- 首帧只播种基线，已空闲的会话不会误报。"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## 开发 / 构建"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"源码用 TypeScript + React（JSX）。构建依赖 deepseek-harness 仓库的共享工具链（会生成 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 包裹与 `l"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ib/types/` 布局），因此推荐在仓库内开发："},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"构建产物在 `packages/client/dsh-completion-notifier/lib/`，把 `lib/` 同步回本仓库即可发布。"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## 目录结构"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
